mapper.sql: id, name, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount, total_quantity AS totalQuantity, issued_quantity AS issuedQuantity, starts_at AS startsAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, CASE WHEN expires_at <= NOW(6) THEN 'ENDED' ELSE status END AS status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt

choose.when: AND (status = 'ENDED' OR (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND expires_at <= NOW(6)))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupons ( name, discount_type, discount_value, minimum_order_amount, maximum_discount_amount, total_quantity, starts_at, expires_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{minimumOrderAmount}, #{maximumDiscountAmount}, #{totalQuantity}, #{startsAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount, total_quantity AS totalQuantity, issued_quantity AS issuedQuantity, starts_at AS startsAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, CASE WHEN expires_at <= NOW(6) THEN 'ENDED' ELSE status END AS status FROM coupons
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN expires_at <= NOW(6) THEN 3 WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN status = 'INACTIVE' THEN 2 ELSE 4 END,
CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > NOW(6) THEN expires_at END ASC,
CASE WHEN status = 'INACTIVE' AND expires_at > NOW(6) THEN updated_at END DESC,
CASE WHEN expires_at <= NOW(6) THEN expires_at END DESC,
id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET name = #{name}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, minimum_order_amount = #{minimumOrderAmount}, maximum_discount_amount = #{maximumDiscountAmount}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND starts_at > NOW(6) AND expires_at > NOW(6)
UPDATE coupons SET status = 'ENDED' WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND expires_at <= NOW(6)
